# Tiny Treats — House Plants

Selected assets from **Tiny Treats - House Plants set 1.0 FREE** by Tiny Treats.

- Source: https://tinytreats.itch.io/house-plants
- License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0)
- Imported formats: glTF, binary mesh data, and the shared gradient atlas

Only the plant variants used by the card-shop scene are included here.
